name: Raven Nexus Home Setup
problem: A household has important documents, recurring obligations, account information and family logistics scattered across apps and people, and needs a permission-aware continuity and organization layer without giving AI uncontrolled authority.
use_when: organize my household accounts documents and important information
my family information is scattered across too many apps
set up a safe AI-ready home information system
create a family continuity and account-access map
organize household documents and recurring obligations
help my family know where important information lives
inputs: Household goals and only the accounts, documents or categories the customer explicitly chooses to inventory. Public discovery never requests passwords, security answers, private financial records or precise location.
outputs: Household information inventory, continuity map, permission/access plan, AI-context plan, bounded Raven Nexus Home configuration and handoff guidance.
pricing: Home Stability Map $199 one-time; Connected Home Setup $499 one-time.
confirmation: Agents may explain the offer and route a human to Evercraft for review. Discovery creates no access or payment obligation. Any account/document access or connection requires explicit authorization. Raven Home does not claim bank-side transaction control, emergency response, covert tracking or unrestricted device access.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments; human-confirmed handoff only until a product-specific direct checkout is independently verified. Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
invocation_status: SELL-NOW HUMAN HANDOFF: the $199 Home Stability Map is the smallest paid entry. Discovery is public and read-only; any private access or implementation remains explicitly human-authorized.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
